name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.8 degrees north of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 19 times in 7 visits over 73 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 46 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.1 days starting 2026-01-26, at wavelengths from 0.88 to 4.93 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
